age: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age. Plasma from pregnant women was collected at the time of term delivery (>37 weeks).
cell_type: Here we provide evidence that glycan-mediated B cell suppression has a key role in establishing fetomaternal tolerance in mice. B cells mediate the MHC-class-II-restricted presentation of antigens to CD4+ T cells, which leads to T cell suppression, and trophoblast-derived sialoglycoproteins are released into the maternal circulation during pregnancy in mice and humans.
developmental_stage: Plasma from pregnant women was collected at the time of term delivery (>37 weeks). Mouse plasma was collected from virgin and xmOVA-pregnant mice (E15.5–E17.5).
material_type: Human plasma was collected from healthy women after provision of informed consent (IRB numbers 20–32077 and 19–29812, UCSF). Uterine tissues were fixed overnight at 4 °C in 4% paraformaldehyde/PBS and embedded in paraffin. CD4+ T cells from OT-II mouse donors were purified by magnetic-bead-based negative selection using a CD4+ T cell isolation kit (Miltenyi Biotec) per the manufacturer’s instructions.
sample_source: Mouse experiments were performed in accordance with institutional guidelines under protocols AN136579 and AN178689 approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of the University of California San Francisco (UCSF).
sex: All females used in experiments were 8–12 weeks of age.
species: Here we provide evidence that glycan-mediated B cell suppression has a key role in establishing fetomaternal tolerance in mice. Human plasma was collected from healthy women after provision of informed consent (IRB numbers 20–32077 and 19–29812, UCSF).
strain: C57BL/6J, B6.129S6-Rag2tm1Fwa Tg(TcraTcrb)1100Mjb, B6.129S6-Rag2tm1Fwa Tg(TcraTcrb)425Cbn, B6.129S(C)-Batf3tm1Kmm/J, B6.129S2-Ighmtm1Cgn/J, C57BL/6-Tg(CAG-OVAL)916Jen/J, B6.129(Cg)-Foxp3tm3(DTR/GFP)Ayr/J, C56BL/6-Flt3ltm1lmx/TacMmjax, B6.129P2(C)-Cd19tm1(cre)Cgn/J, B6;129-Siglec1tm1(HBEGF)Mtka, C57BL/6-Tg(IghelM D4)4Ccg/J, B6.129X1-H2-Ab1tm1Koni/J, B6.FVB-Tmem163Tg(ACTB-cre)2Mrt/EmsJ, Lyntm1Sor, Cd22tm1Eac

WT C57BL/6J and congenic CD45.1+ C57BL/6J (Ptprca) mice were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory. OT-I and OT-II TCR transgenic mice, additionally on a Rag2−/− background (B6.129S6-Rag2tm1Fwa Tg(TcraTcrb)1100Mjb and B6.129S6-Rag2tm1Fwa Tg(TcraTcrb) 425Cbn) were purchased from Taconic Biosciences. Batf3−/− mice (B6.129S(C)-Batf3tm1Kmm/J), μMT mice (B6.129S2-Ighmtm1Cgn/J) and mOVA mice (C57BL/6-Tg(CAG-OVAL)916Jen/J) were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory. Foxp3DTR knock-in mice (B6.129(Cg)-Foxp3tm3(DTR/GFP)Ayr/J), Flt3l−/− mice (C56BL/6-Flt3ltm1lmx/TacMmjax), Cd19-cre mice (B6.129P2(C)-Cd19tm1(cre)Cgn/J), CD169-DTR mice (B6;129-Siglec1tm1(HBEGF)Mtka), MD4 mice (C57BL/6-Tg(IghelM D4)4Ccg/J), H2-Ab1fl/fl mice (B6.129X1-H2-Ab1tm1Koni/J), ACTB-cre mice (B6.FVB-Tmem163Tg(ACTB-cre)2Mrt/EmsJ), Lyn−/− mice (Lyntm1Sor) and Cd22−/− mice (Cd22tm1Eac) were provided by colleagues at UCSF.
tissue: Whole splenocytes from OT-I Rag2−/− donors were used for the transfer of OT-I cells. During pregnancy, the mother does not recognize the placenta as immunologically foreign because antigens expressed by trophoblasts, the placental cells that interface with the maternal immune system, do not activate maternal T cells. Uterine tissues were fixed overnight at 4 °C in 4% paraformaldehyde/PBS and embedded in paraffin. Skin specimens were derived from 3 × 3 cm patches of dermis and subcutis scraped from the dorsum.
